notes: BPSK +-1 shaped with a raised cosine (roll-off 0.35, p(0) = 1, 16 symbols per side), sps 4.1, symbol k at the transmit position offset + k sps, 40 ppm clock drift (receive sample n is the transmit position n (1 + 40e-6), D540), complex noise for Eb/N0 20 dB from the measured power per sample; Gardner with the block defaults (loop_bw 0.01, damping 0.7071, max_deviation 0.005, ted_gain 1); exact float32 model of D530 to D537 over the whole input in one call; produced is the output count; timing_error_last_256 is the largest distance of the last 256 strobes from a symbol centre in symbols (information); snr_db_guard compares with the float64 loop (D111)
